children: August PPI rises 0.4% month-over-month, matching the WSJ consensus. Year-over-year PPI is up 5.4% versus the rise of 5.3% that was expected. Treasury yields are still climbing as the conflict with Iran remains in focus for investors and oil prices continue to rise. The U.S. 10-year yield now sits around 4.90%, up from 4.89% before the report. The U.S. 2-year yield sits around 4.50%, up from 4.48% before the report. (jessica.coacci@wsj.com)
